data.name: 1000km
data.detailed_description:
Ahead of you lie 1000 kilometers. Beneath you sits an old car that remembers better days and promises you nothing. So begins 1000 km, a co-op road-trip adventure where the journey matters more than the finish line.

🛣️ A ROAD 1000 KM LONG

Sunrises over the highway, all-night drives, headlights in the fog and the distant glow of a gas station. Snack stops, hot coffee in a paper cup, conversations in the cabin. This journey feels real: it has its own rhythm, its own fatigue and its own small joys. And the road won't let you get bored, because it always has something new in store.

🚗 A CAR WITH CHARACTER

Your clunker isn't just transport, it's a full member of the crew. It groans on the climbs, acts up in the mornings, and will surprise you at the worst possible moment. To keep it alive you'll listen to it, fix it, improvise with whatever's at hand, and talk it into going just a little further. The longer you travel together, the more attached you get.

🤝 BETTER TOGETHER

While one of you holds the wheel, the other flips through the service manual, keeps an eye on the car and decides where to stop. The road tests your crew: there will be panic, there will be laughter, and there will be moments when everything rests on trusting your co-pilot. Travel as one team, or turn it into a race and find out whose clunker gets there first.

🎲 EVERY RUN TELLS A DIFFERENT STORY

You never know in advance what car you'll end up with or what will happen on the way. One run will be remembered for an engine miraculously coming back to life in the middle of the night, another for the dumbest breakdown a hundred meters from a gas station. These are the moments that turn into stories you'll keep retelling for years.

Start the engine. 1000 km to go. Will you make it?

1000 km is in active development. The project keeps growing, and some details may change before release. Add it to your wishlist and be among the first to hit the road.
